description: Design tokens for the Symphony Bento redesign, read from the interactive prototype on 2026-11-18. Sizes are dp (CSS px in the prototype); type sizes are sp. Colors are HSL formulas where "h" is the user-selected primary hue; "hex" gives the resolved value for each of the five primary hues (8-digit hex includes alpha). A literal hue (e.g. hsl(0 0% 0%)) resolves to one hex for all hues.

modes.system: Follows the OS: light or dark.
modes.black: Dark with a pure black background for OLED; surfaces slightly darker than dark.

schemes.tinted: Default. Surfaces carry a little of the primary hue.
schemes.neutral: Near-gray surfaces; color only on accent and tonal.
schemes.vivid: Stronger tint on surfaces and fuller selection colors.
schemes.contrast: Black or white background, tiles outlined with a 1 dp "line" ring, highest text contrast.

colorRoles.surface: Default tile and list-tile fill (tone "plain"); the phone player sheet.
colorRoles.raised: Hover and pressed fill on rows; lyrics and queue panel inside the player; search hits.
colorRoles.float: Floating player window on wide screens.
colorRoles.muted: Tertiary text (durations, disabled letters in the A-Z index, grip).
colorRoles.line: Hairlines, outlined buttons, tile outlines in the Contrast scheme.
colorRoles.track: Unplayed part of the seek bar and capsule progress ring.
colorRoles.accent: Primary actions only: play buttons, selected tab, Play all tile, active smart filter, seek progress.
colorRoles.tonal: Selection and one secondary highlight: rail selection, chips that are on, Shuffle tile, timer button when on.
colorRoles.edge: Hairline ring (1 px, spread) around floating surfaces.
colorRoles.scrim: Dim layer behind the phone player sheet and action sheets.

elevation.floating: Floating surfaces (floating player window, capsule, menus) use: fill "float" (player) or "high" (capsule, menus), shadow from color.<scheme>.<mode>.shadow, plus a 1 dp ring in "edge".

weights.500: group row titles, menu items, rail labels
weights.600: row and tile titles, buttons, tabs, chips, small labels
weights.700: page, player and group titles, stats, letter headers

typography.trackingRule: Negative letter spacing only at 18 sp and up: -0.01em at 18-22 sp, -0.02em at 28 sp and up.

pageTitle.use: Page title in the header on rail layouts.

pageTitleShort.use: Page title on short windows and sub-pages (Album).

display.use: Stat value, album title, Now playing tile title over artwork.

title.use: Player song title (medium level), Now playing tile title, large tile labels, lyrics lines.

groupTitle.use: Grouped tile title (album, artist, genre, playlist, folder); player song title at the small level.

rowTitle.use: Song row title, tile label, capsule title, menu header. Group rows use 15/500.

body.use: Artist line in the player and Now playing tile. Buttons, tabs and chips use 14/600.

secondary.use: Artist and album lines, durations, tile sub-labels. Tile header labels, letter headers (700) and player extras use 13/600.

label.use: Small labels, rail labels (500, 700 when selected), timer badge (700).

gutter.note: Page side padding. compact = window width < 600.

radius.rule: Nested corners: inner radius = outer radius - padding.

phoneSheet.mediumHeight: content height + 20 (cover is a full-width square)

floatingPlayer.from: translateY(24) scale(.92), opacity 0, origin bottom right

bentoGrid.note: Chosen from the main column width (window minus navigation). [columns, row height, gap].

breakpoints.songsColumns: Title / Artist / Album / Time columns when inner width >= 720
breakpoints.searchSideColumn: Filters move to a 320 dp sticky side column when inner width >= 720 and the window is not short
